mod.help: Settings for the Journey HUD mod.

enabled.label: Target bar
enabled.help: Show the health and poise of the enemy you are locked on to.

numbers.label: Health numbers
numbers.help: Show the exact health above the target bar.

scale.label: Size
scale.help: Size of the target bar. 1 = normal.

offset_x.label: Right margin
offset_x.help: Distance from the right edge of the screen.

offset_y.label: Top margin
offset_y.help: Distance from the top edge of the screen.
